items.title: «Окна возможностей» для прекращения войны в Украине, говорит SACEUR
items.original_title: 'Windows of Opportunity' to End War in Ukraine, SACEUR Says
items.rss_summary: NATO Supreme Allied Commander Europe (SACEUR) General Alexus G. Grynkewich - the alliance's top military commander - says the alliance should increase support to Ukraine when they're hit by Russian hybrid attacks. On the "brutal" war, he said there are "windows of opportunity" to bring the conflict to an end and that the alliance should seize them where possible to bring both sides to the table. He made the comments in his first interview with Bloomberg TV's Oliver Crook in Warsaw on Sunday Oct.

items.title: Иран заявляет, что реакция США на его предложение открыть Ормуз была «недостаточной»
items.original_title: Iran says US response to its proposal to reopen Hormuz was 'insufficient'
items.rss_summary: DUBAI, Oct 11 (Reuters) - The United States' response to Iran's seven conditions in a proposal to reopen the strategic Strait of Hormuz was "insufficient", Iran's security chief, Mohsen Rezaei, was quoted by state media on Sunday as saying. Iran presented a proposal during the UN General Assembly under which the Strait of Hormuz waterway could be reopened and normal maritime passage restored within seven days if the conditions were met, to which the US later replied via Qatari intermediaries.
